deep_dive_reason: No candidate cleared the bar. The two items with deep-dive-grade technical depth (Kemp LoadMaster exploitation confirmation, KVM shadow-MMU escape) are both delta updates on prior coverage and must carry only the delta; the highest-relevance new item (the DPRK mass-breach disclosure) rests on journalism without the technical substrate a kill-chain treatment needs. Depth was not manufactured to fill the slot.

drops.title: Elastic — npm min-release-age removal invisible to log-tailing telemetry
drops.reason: borderline-drop: genuine detection-engineering point but framed around one vendor's own agent integration, and the underlying principle (removal of a control is an event append-only tailing cannot see) is already familiar to this audience

drops.title: SSD Disclosure — Linux kernel net/bridge STP timer use-after-free
drops.reason: out-of-window: primary source 2026-08-05, window_hours=26; also a no-CVE local privilege-escalation primitive handled by the normal kernel patch cycle

drops.title: Bol / De Bijenkorf customer-data breach via CEVA Logistics
drops.reason: borderline-drop: no disclosed intrusion mechanism, no actor, no transferable technical lesson; the shared-third-party access-path lesson is carried with far more substance by the Beacon CRM entry in the same window

drops.title: Levi Strauss 8-K tied to the UNC6671 extortion ecosystem
drops.reason: borderline-drop: the 8-K names neither actor nor technique, and the campaign link reaches this run only as a third-hand relay of Reuters citing Google data; yesterday's UNC6671 entry already carries the mechanics and the defender action is unchanged

corrections_applied_at_triage: Flowise CVE-2026-67622 was returned as 'CVSS 9.9 critical'; the CNA record (VulnCheck) scores it CVSS 4.0 8.5 — the authority governs and 9.9 is not carried
KVM item was returned as 'two 16-year-old bugs'; only Januscape (CVE-2026-53359) traces to the 2010 commit — Zapscape is a separate, newly assigned CVE
CPDLC: CISA's CSAF records remediation category none_available AND states exploitation is unlikely outside a lab setting — that hedge governs the entry's priority
CVE-2026-8037 and CVE-2026-53359 were both already in the store-wide CVE index (covered >14 days ago), so both ship as update_of deltas rather than new entries
